integrity: A single orbit of eight elementary free-face collapses, a separate complete acyclic neighborhood-complex Morse matching, exhaustive graph-coloring and automorphism checks, and exact signed fixed-simplex traces support the theorem. No independent external scientific audit has occurred.
limitations: The theorem concerns only the explicitly defined graph; it establishes an equivariant collapse of its independence complex onto its open-neighborhood complex and a homology character, not a classification of free group actions on spheres or a general family theorem.
title: An equivariant collapse connecting the Chvátal independence and neighborhood complexes
